dogecoin.text: @Harpua71 @dragon1204 @chhlss If I made 30k a year in salary and made 5k from  dogecoin in one month I pay ZERO capital gains! I pay my regular income taxes in an AGI of 35k

@Harpua71 @chhlss If you have ZERO income and made 5k off of dogecoin you will not be taxed at a 40% gain...it's basic math. Capital gains adds to your AGI and if you aren't making much annual money to begin with the small amount you're making won't push your AGI into higher taxable brackets

@chhlss Let's say you have a salary of 30k a year and made 5k on trading dogecoin likely you'll be taxed at a bracket of an annual income of 35k ....it becomes more of an issue for people in higher income earning.brackets where they start getting hit with 40% capital gains taxes
